findings.title: Authorization Policy Violation: Unbound Identifier in GetVehicleLocationHandler
findings.description: Controller extracts sensitive object identifier 'vehicle_id' from URL parameters and queries database without asserting session tenant boundaries.
findings.remediation: Ensure queries include authenticated tenant context: db.Where("id = ? AND tenant_id = ?", vehicle_id, session.TenantID).
